inputAdapters.allowed: Normalize typed search text through Language Kernel synonyms before Search Kernel ranking.
May transcribe speech and translate it into structured SearchIntent candidates with confidence and explanation.
inputAdapters.forbidden: Must not execute writes or bypass Admission Kernel, Operations Runtime, Control Plane, or Evidence Graph.

privacyRules: Do not show another user's raw query text.
Store and rank by canonical intent id when possible.
Recommendations must pass Search Kernel permission policy and Admission Kernel visibility.
Recommendations must never grant confirmAllowed or productionAllowed.

projectionAdapters.name: ProjectionWorkspaceSearchAdapter
projectionAdapters.allowed: May provide current workspace-card projection results only as input to SearchKernelService.
projectionAdapters.forbidden: Must not be treated as final Search Kernel and must not bypass Language Kernel synonyms, permission policy, or Admission Kernel.
projectionAdapters.removalCondition: SearchKernelService owns indexing, ranking, admission, trace refs, and language explain output.

projectionAdapters.name: searchIntentHub
projectionAdapters.allowed: May adapt backend or fallback results to mobile navigation view models.
projectionAdapters.forbidden: Must not decide business production permission or business-line maturity.

invariants: Every SearchResult includes an admission object.
Blocked business lines cannot be made executable by search ranking.
Search uses Language Kernel synonyms and domain terms.
Contains-only matching is allowed only inside registered projection adapters.
Search visibility is not confirm permission.
